name: MsoCalloutDropType
description: Specifies the starting position of the callout line relative to the text bounding box. Used with the PresetDrop method of the CalloutFormat object.

constants.name: msoCalloutDropMixed
constants.description: Return value only; indicates a combination of the other states.

constants.name: msoCalloutDropCustom
constants.description: Custom. If this value is used as the value for the PresetDrop property, the Drop and AutoAttach properties of the CalloutFormat object are used to determine where the callout line attaches to the text box.
